text:
maria: quick async standup — microshift handoff for GPU capacity

maria: did: finished the cross-region prewarm script (adds AZ tags + node labels), tested on staging eu-west-1, warmup timing looks sane
maria: blocker: quota request for extra g5 GPUs still pending (INF-4521). Support asked for a 7d usage matrix — need someone to pull node_gpu_util + spot-eviction-rate
cheng: I can pull that. do you want raw CloudWatch csv or a summarized table?
maria: CSV is fine, include timestamps and instance_type tag if possible
ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west-1 spot pool at 91% capacity (g5), 2 preemptions in the last hour. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/ops/gpu
nick: FYI I increased prewarm headroom from 6 -> 8 nodes in eu-west-1 earlier, freed ~15% queue fill. Left a short note on the runbook
sara: blocker: rolling update on dedicated fleet stalled at 18% — drain hook timing out on hv-3 hosts. Opened INF-4523 with logs and stack traces
maria: can someone approve temporary bypass to requeue the stalled pods so rollout continues?
nick: approved. I'll run the bypass and monitor for side effects
cheng: quick snippet I use to export metrics: ```aws cloudwatch get-metric-data --metric-data-queries file://queries.json --start-time 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-17T00:00:00Z --region eu-west-1 > eu-west-gpu-7d.csv```
sara: thanks — that helps. Drain hook fix is a small retry loop; I'll push PR after I re-run the failing nodes
nick: running bypass now (INF-4523 bypass script). Requeued 12 pods, watching for CPU/GPU spikes.
nick: rollout resumed, currently at 37% -> monitoring, ETA ~12m
maria: today: finalize quota email (attach CSV), ping cloud support, finish canary for model-v3.2 (needs cache warmup tweak)
sara: today: patch drain hook, send short regression test for dedicated fleet, will ping @maria for a quick review
cheng: I'll drop the CSV into #infra-exports in ~8m and link it here
maria: perfect, thanks — once CSV is in I’ll assemble the usage matrix and send it to support. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled node maintenance in eu-west-1 tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. If you need to preserve capacity, request exception by EOD
maria: noted. will include maintenance window in the quota request
